criteria.evidence: The composite-key half holds and is now verified against a database at exact journal head; the 'and supporting index' half fails and no gate measures it. Composite-key half: `check:tenant-relationships` with TENANT_RELATIONSHIP_DB_URL=scratch_cold_1010 exits 0 — 'Ledger rows on target 685 of 685 journal entries · Total single-col FKs 214 · EXCL: CRM 79 · EXCL: Inventory 134 · EXCL: platform-global 1 · Actionable 0 · OK — zero actionable single-column tenant FKs' (this gate was recorded exit 2 in the sweep purely because TENANT_RELATIONSHIP_DB_URL was unset). `check:tenant-indexes` exits 0 — '347 schema files, 840 tenant tables, 840 leading tenant index'. Supporting-index half: measured by me directly on scratch_head_1010 — of 1,522 composite foreign keys, 653 have NO index (total or partial) whose leading columns equal the FK's column set, so every parent delete or key update on those relationships probes the referencing side without an index. Postgres does not create one automatically. `check:tenant-indexes` cannot see this: it asserts one leading-tenant-column index PER TABLE (840/840), never that a RELATIONSHIP has a supporting index. That is unchanged from the 654/1,522 the prior report measured at 677. Removal half: 11 exact-duplicate single-column FKs WERE removed by migration 1056 (catalog now has 0 exact-duplicate FK groups, single-column FKs 1677->1666), and 1056's DO block re-proves per pair that the survivor is identical in every pg_constraint column before dropping, which satisfies 'only after all callers and migrations target the composite relationship'. 153 single-column FKs are still strictly superseded by a composite FK containing their column, and none of those have been removed.
criteria.blocker: 653 of 1,522 composite tenant foreign keys have no supporting index, and no gate asserts the property, so nothing would catch the 654th. To close: extend check-tenant-indexes.mjs with a per-composite-FK population (require an index whose leading columns equal the FK's column set), baseline the current 653 as a ratchet, and index at minimum the 32 organization_members composite FKs with no index at all.
criteria.clauses_failing: 'and supporting index' — 653/1,522 composite FKs are unsupported at head, and check:tenant-indexes' 840/840 measures a different property (per-table leading tenant index). The composite-key clause and the 'remove a redundant single-column FK only after ...' guard both hold.
